Decision: push. Reason: An on-call simulator mini-game is a clever, creative way of representing the stress of being on-call, with rules that capture the reality of on-call work in an amusing and relatable way.</think>{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个模拟“值班”（on-call）的迷你游戏，用一种巧妙、幽默的方式重现了值班时的压力和现实，通过规则映射真实工作场景（比如未处理的警报会扣钱、现实生活打断会倒计时等），是很生动有趣的创意。" }
